title: Positive finite coefficient sheaves, their completed limit and evaluation
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with its specified valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $n\in\mathbf N$ set $Q_n=A/(\varpi^{n+1})$, lifted to the coefficient universe $u+1$ for $E:\mathrm{Type}_u$ and $X:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$. For $n\le m$ define $Q_m\to Q_n$ by the quotient factor map induced by the identity on $A$. Let $T_X:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathrm{CRing}_{u+1})$ have value the constant ring sheaf $(Q_n)_X$ at $n$ and the constant sheaf maps induced by these quotient maps; constant sheaves mean sheafifications of constant presheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define $B_X=\varprojlim T_X$ in sheaves of commutative rings. Give $Q_n$ the discrete topology and define $C_{n,X}$ to be the continuous-function ring sheaf $U\mapsto C(|U|,Q_n)$ with pointwise operations and restrictions by precomposition. For $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $s\in C_{n,X}(U)$ and $x\in |U|$, define $\operatorname{ev}_{n,U,x}(s)=s(x)\in Q_n$. These definitions make no identification between $B_X$ and a continuous integral coefficient sheaf, or between $(Q_n)_X$ and $C_{n,X}$.
